solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Noticeable'** is spelled correctly.
 
• The other options contain incorrect spellings:
 
 
• **Option 2:** 'Noticable' - Missing the letter 'e' after 'c'.
 
• **Option 3:** 'Noticeble' - Missing the letter 'a' after 'e'.
 
• **Option 4:** 'Noticible' - Incorrect placement of 'i' and 'e'.
 
 
 
• The word 'Noticeable' means something that is easy to see, recognize, or be perceived. **(ध्यान देने योग्य)**
 
• **For Example:** The changes in the design were noticeable to everyone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonly Confused Spellings:**
 
 
• **Achieve:** Often misspelled as 'Acheive'.
 
• **Separate:** Commonly written as 'Seperate'.
 
• **Definitely:** Frequently misspelled as 'Definately'.
